title: OpenWhisker Phase 6 SCHEDULE.md frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a sibling SCHEDULE.md file. Only triggering fields are accepted; all agent runtime configuration (engine, vault_tools, vault_scope, budget) lives in SKILL.md.

id.description: Must equal the sibling SKILL.md id.

enabled.description: Master switch for cron triggering. When false, ad-hoc triggers still work.

cron_expr.description: Standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week).

_phase5_compat.description: These fields are accepted with a deprecation warning for Phase 5 vault compatibility but should be migrated to SKILL.md.

_phase6_reject.description: These fields cause a lint error when present in SCHEDULE.md. They belong in SKILL.md only.
